parsed_json.up: Select compound ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, compound key, publication identifier (PubMed ID or DOI), assay description, standard type, standard relation, standard value, standard units, activity comment, target ChEMBL ID, target name, and target organism. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then to assays on assay_id, then to target_dictionary on tid, and to docs on doc_id. Join compound_structures on molregno as an inner join. Join compound_records on record_id as a left join to retrieve compound_key. Filter by target ChEMBL ID CHEMBL274 and standard_type IC50. Return all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, compound key, publication identifier, assay description, standard type, standard relation, standard value, standard units, activity comment, target ChEMBL ID, target name, and target organism.
